about: Rack 1 of the R0.7 continuous test (2026-10-21 05:26 UTC, iPhone 16 Pro Max, low side, home 7 ft, 9-ball). Checked by eye by Claude from the video (1 fps overview, 4-6 fps around every shot, 60 fps at the foul). First ball hit was checked frame by frame only for shots A, D (4 fps) and F (60 fps); for the others it is the lowest ball and looked legal at 4-6 fps. Times are seconds from the start of the recording; 'at' = cue strike. The player announced a possible foul without saying which; the foul below was found independently.

shots.note: the empty rack frame was left on the cloth and slid to the foot rail; removed by hand at 20-22 s
one rail first, then the 1; the 1 stops at the near side pocket
cue ball ends frozen to the 9; a hand rests on the rail at 89-90 s without touching a ball

shots.foul: wrong ball first: the cue ball (kicked off the near rail) contacts the 5 at 114.82 s before the 3, the lowest ball; the 5 goes in the far side pocket
shots.note: 3 and 5 were close together; checked at 60 fps
the player's body hides most of the table from 138 to 147 s
the player's head hides the near half at 184-189 s
after the last shot a cue and a glove are laid on the cloth (202-205 s)
